einzeiler: Listener stories about developing romantic feelings for a therapist.
kurzfassung: Caroline shares her experience of starting a romantic relationship with her therapist after years of treatment. Host Anna hears from other listeners who experienced romantic feelings in therapy. Psychologist Sally Openshaw discusses erotic transference.
stichpunkte: Caroline's romantic relationship with her therapist
Listener stories about romantic feelings in therapy
Discussion on erotic transference with psychologist Sally Openshaw
beschreibung:
Caroline started going to therapy as a teenager because of depression. After a couple of years working together, she expressed a fantasy. “I had a vision of us dancing to Pachelbel's Canon” she told him. Caroline's therapist was 45-years-old and married, but they soon started a romantic relationship.
In this episode, Anna hears from Caroline and other listeners about when romantic feelings come up in therapy and unpacks it all with Sally Openshaw, a psychologist and expert who studies erotic transference.
Podcast production by Zoe Azulay
